background.label: Background
background.help: Background color, usually the key color: pure blue or green.

foreground.label: Line color
foreground.help: Color of the lines when the fill mode is "solid".

analysis.fft_size.label: FFT size
analysis.fft_size.help: FFT length in samples, a power of two. Longer resolves low notes better but reacts more slowly.

analysis.bands.label: Bands
analysis.bands.help: Number of frequency bands, one line or bar each.

analysis.frequency_scale.label: Frequency axis
analysis.frequency_scale.help: "log" spreads low and high frequencies evenly across the width; "linear" gives every Hz the same width.

analysis.max_frequency.label: Highest frequency (Hz)
analysis.max_frequency.help: Upper edge in Hz; limited to the audio's Nyquist frequency (inf means up to Nyquist).

analysis.magnitude_scale.label: Level scale
analysis.magnitude_scale.help: "db" shows levels on a decibel scale down to the dB floor; "linear" shows amplitudes directly.

analysis.db_floor.label: dB floor
analysis.db_floor.help: Level shown as zero height on the dB scale; full scale is 0 dB.

analysis.gain.label: Gain
analysis.gain.help: Multiplier on all levels before scaling.

analysis.tilt_db_per_octave.label: Tilt (dB per octave)
analysis.tilt_db_per_octave.help: Boost per octave above 1 kHz (and cut below it), so the bands look more even.

analysis.channel.label: Channel
analysis.channel.help: Which audio to analyze: "mix" of both channels, "left" or "right".

analysis.attack_seconds.label: Rise time (s)
analysis.attack_seconds.help: How fast lines rise, in seconds; 0 follows the audio directly.

analysis.release_seconds.label: Fall time (s)
analysis.release_seconds.help: How fast lines fall, in seconds; 0 follows the audio directly.

analysis.low_fft_size.label: Bass FFT size
analysis.low_fft_size.help: 0 = off. A longer FFT for the bands below the crossover, so bass notes show as separate peaks; bass lines then react a little earlier and fall a little later.

analysis.low_crossover_frequency.label: Bass crossover (Hz)
analysis.low_crossover_frequency.help: Bands below it use the bass FFT; the two are blended over one octave around it.

look.kind.label: Look
look.kind.help: The look: "flat" lines or bars, or "perspective" as in the legacy Unity scene.

look.margin_x.label: Side margin
look.margin_x.help: Empty space left and right, as a fraction of the frame width.

look.baseline_y.label: Baseline position
look.baseline_y.help: Baseline position, as a fraction of the frame height from the top.

look.max_height.label: Height
look.max_height.help: Height of a full-scale band on one side of the baseline, as a fraction of the frame height.

look.mirror.label: Mirror
look.mirror.help: Grow both up and down from the baseline.

look.bar_fill.label: Line width
look.bar_fill.help: Fraction of each band's slot covered by its line; the rest is the gap.

look.min_bar_width_px.label: Minimum line width (px)
look.min_bar_width_px.help: Lines are never thinner than this, in pixels.

look.min_height_px.label: Minimum height (px)
look.min_height_px.help: Every band is at least this tall on each side, so the baseline stays visible.

look.response.label: Response
look.response.help: Exponent applied to band values: above 1 keeps quiet bands low and lets peaks stand out.

look.style.label: Style
look.style.help: "bars": one solid line or bar per band; "blocks": each bar split into segments, like an LED meter.

look.block_height_px.label: Block height (px)
look.block_height_px.help: Height of one segment. A segment shows only once the bar reaches its full height.

look.block_gap_px.label: Block gap (px)
look.block_gap_px.help: Gap between segments, and around the baseline when mirrored.

look.first_x.label: First box position
look.first_x.help: Position of the first box along the row, in scene units.

look.spacing.label: Spacing
look.spacing.help: Distance between neighboring boxes, in scene units.

look.box_size.label: Box size
look.box_size.help: Slightly wider than the spacing so neighboring boxes overlap and no seams show between them.

look.depth.label: Depth
look.depth.help: Distance of the row from the scene origin along the view direction, in scene units.

look.height_scale.label: Height scale
look.height_scale.help: Box height for a band value of 1, in scene units.

look.camera_position.label: Camera position
look.camera_position.help: Camera position (x, y, z) in scene units.

look.camera_pitch_degrees.label: Camera tilt (°)
look.camera_pitch_degrees.help: How far the camera looks down, in degrees.

look.vertical_fov_degrees.label: Field of view (°)
look.vertical_fov_degrees.help: Vertical field of view of the camera, in degrees.

fill.mode.label: Fill
fill.mode.help: "solid": the line color; "frequency": a gradient from left to right; "height": a gradient from the baseline to the tip.

fill.colors.label: Gradient colors
fill.colors.help: Gradient stops, evenly spaced: at least two colors for a gradient.

fx.glow_radius_px.label: Glow size (px)
fx.glow_radius_px.help: How far a soft halo spreads around the lines; 0 turns the glow off. On a key color it mixes with the background.
